morrowPolicy.selection: Only the exact target with a recognized method and no non-null impersonator can yield observed_active; either independent impersonation signal denies. Unknown, absent, null, padded or differently cased target methods hold.
morrowPolicy.shapeVsEligibility: Nullable impersonator reason is valid row shape. A different valid impersonated or unknown-method row does not disqualify a normal target; malformed rows anywhere still hold.
morrowPolicy.pagination: Complete bounded pagination and explicit before/after metadata remain required. Optional SDK list metadata types are not evidence that endpoint omission or completeness has been qualified.
morrowPolicy.cryptography: The unchanged72 verifier independently rejects act. The reader correction adds consistency checking; it does not replace token verification.
morrowPolicy.provenance: Application/client binding remains expected_only; provider liveness remains not_guaranteed. The allowlist is Morrow policy, not proof of physical human presence or immediate revocation.

findingScope: Canonical78 records an offline synthetic reproduction against the prior reader. No actual WorkOS wire exploit was demonstrated or tested.
qualificationLimit: Offline Node/Workers/local SQL policy qualification only. No new sign-in, key acquisition, live session-list read, issuer or merchant authority.
